title: Oddiy matnni o‘qish va tinglab tushunish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida qisqa matn yoki dialogning asosiy fikrini topasiz, undan ism, son va joy nomlarini eshitib olasiz, kalit so‘zlar strategiyasidan foydalanasiz va 5 ta tushunish savolidan kamida 4 tasiga to‘g‘ri javob berasiz.

scenes.title: Xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda transport turlarini, “by bus” va “on foot” iboralarini hamda chipta olishni o‘rgandik. Bugun boshqacha dars: yangi grammatika emas, balki ko‘nikma. Biz oddiy matnni o‘qib va qisqa dialogni tinglab tushunishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida qisqa matnning asosiy fikrini topa olasiz, dialogdan ism, son va joy nomlarini eshitib ola olasiz va savollarga to‘g‘ri javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Hello and welcome! Today we will read short texts and listen to short dialogues. Let's understand English together.
scenes.say_uz: Salom va xush kelibsiz! Bugun qisqa matnlarni o‘qiymiz va qisqa dialoglarni tinglaymiz. Keling, ingliz tilini birga tushunamiz.

scenes.title: Ikki xil tushunish
board: Main idea (asosiy fikr) — What is it about?
Details (tafsilotlar) — Who? Where? When? How many?
scenes.say_native: Matnni yoki dialogni tushunishning ikki darajasi bor. Birinchisi — asosiy fikr, inglizcha “main idea”. Bu savolga javob: matn umuman nima haqida? Ikkinchisi — tafsilotlar, ya’ni “details”: kim, qayerda, qachon, nechta. Ko‘p o‘quvchilar birinchi o‘qishdayoq har bir so‘zni tushunishga harakat qiladi va charchab qoladi. To‘g‘ri yo‘l boshqacha: avval umumiy rasmni ko‘ring, keyin kerakli tafsilotni qidiring. Bugun shu ikki qadamni mashq qilamiz.
scenes.say: First, ask: what is it about? Then ask: who, where, when and how many?
scenes.say_uz: Avval so‘rang: bu nima haqida? Keyin so‘rang: kim, qayerda, qachon va nechta?

scenes.title: Asosiy fikr qayerda?
scenes.say_native: Asosiy fikrni qanday topamiz? Uchta yordamchi bor. Birinchisi — sarlavha, “title”. Agar matn tepasida “My Day” deb yozilgan bo‘lsa, matn kun tartibi haqida. Ikkinchisi — birinchi gap. Inglizcha matnlarda muallif odatda asosiy gapni boshida aytadi. Uchinchisi — takrorlanadigan so‘zlar. Agar “football” so‘zi matnda to‘rt marta uchrasa, matn deyarli albatta futbol haqida. Bu uch belgiga qarash uchun matnni boshidan oxirigacha o‘qish shart emas.
scenes.say: Look at the title. Read the first sentence. Find the words that repeat.
scenes.say_uz: Sarlavhaga qarang. Birinchi gapni o‘qing. Takrorlanadigan so‘zlarni toping.

scenes.title: Birinchi matn: Dilnoza
board: I'm from Namangan, but now I live in Tashkent.
I'm a student. I study English.
I get up at seven and go to university by metro.
In the evening I work in a café. I'm busy, but I'm happy.
scenes.say_native: Mana birinchi matn. Uni men bilan birga o‘qing va bir vaqtning o‘zida tinglang. Hozircha har bir so‘zga yopishib olmang, faqat bitta savolni o‘ylang: bu matn nima haqida? Matnda Dilnoza ismli qiz o‘zi haqida gapiradi. U qayerdan ekani, qayerda yashashi, nima o‘qishi va kuni qanday o‘tishini aytadi. Ekrandagi gaplarni kuzatib boring.
scenes.say: Hi! My name is Dilnoza. I'm from Namangan, but now I live in Tashkent. I'm a student. I study English and computer science. Every morning I get up at seven and go to university by metro. In the evening I work in a café. I'm busy, but I'm happy.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Mening ismim Dilnoza. Men Namangandanman, lekin hozir Toshkentda yashayman. Men talabaman. Ingliz tili va informatikani o‘qiyman. Har kuni ertalab soat yettida turaman va universitetga metroda boraman. Kechqurun kafeda ishlayman. Bandman, lekin baxtliman.

scenes.title: Asosiy fikrni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Endi tanlang: bu matnning asosiy fikri qaysi? A — Dilnozaning oilasi. B — Dilnozaning kundalik hayoti. C — Namangan taomlari. Javob berishdan oldin o‘zingizdan so‘rang: matnda oila a’zolari haqida gap bormi? Ovqat haqida-chi? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: What is the text about? A, B or C?
scenes.say_uz: Matn nima haqida? A, B yoki C?

scenes.title: Javob: B
board: student · get up · go · work · busy
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob — B, Dilnozaning kundalik hayoti. Qanday bildik? Matnda “student”, “get up at seven”, “go to university”, “work in a café” degan so‘zlar bor. Bularning hammasi kundalik ishlar. Oila haqida bitta ham so‘z yo‘q, Namangan esa faqat bir marta, u qayerdan ekanini aytish uchun tilga olingan. Ko‘rdingizmi: “computer science” degan so‘zni bilmasangiz ham, asosiy fikrni topish mumkin edi.
scenes.say: The answer is B. The text is about Dilnoza's daily life.
scenes.say_uz: Javob — B. Matn Dilnozaning kundalik hayoti haqida.

scenes.title: Har bir so‘zni tarjima qilmang
board: ✓ read everything once → main idea → then details
scenes.say_native: Eng katta xato: birinchi so‘zni lug‘atdan qidirish, keyin ikkinchisini, keyin uchinchisini. Bunda gapning oxiriga yetganingizda boshi esingizdan chiqadi va matn ma’nosi yo‘qoladi. Imtihonda esa vaqt ham yetmaydi. To‘g‘ri yo‘l: avval matnni bir marta to‘xtamasdan o‘qing, notanish so‘zlarni shunchaki o‘tkazib yuboring. Asosiy fikrni tushungandan keyingina kerak bo‘lsa, bir-ikkita muhim so‘zni lug‘atdan qarang.
scenes.say: Don't stop at every new word. Read to the end first.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir yangi so‘zda to‘xtamang. Avval oxirigacha o‘qing.

scenes.title: Notanish so‘zni taxmin qilish
board: I study English and computer science.
scenes.say_native: Notanish so‘z uchrasa, atrofidagi so‘zlarga qarang. “I study English and computer science” gapida “study” — o‘qiyman, “English” — fan nomi. Demak “computer science” ham, ehtimol, fan nomi. Shu yetarli, aniq tarjima shart emas. O‘zbek tilida ham shunday qilamiz: kitobda notanish so‘z chiqsa, gapning mazmunidan taxmin qilamiz. Ingliz tilida ham shu ko‘nikmadan foydalaning. Bu juda ko‘p vaqtni tejaydi.
scenes.say: I study English and computer science. Computer science is a subject.
scenes.say_uz: Men ingliz tili va informatikani o‘qiyman. Informatika — bu fan.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi matn: e’lon
board: Free for students. Bring a friend!
scenes.say_native: Endi boshqa turdagi matn — e’lon. Bunday qisqa matnlarni ko‘chada, maktabda va internetda har kuni ko‘rasiz. E’londa to‘liq gaplar kam, faqat eng kerakli ma’lumot qoladi. Sarlavhaga e’tibor bering: katta harflar bilan “City Library”, ya’ni shahar kutubxonasi deb yozilgan. Keyin “New English Club” — yangi ingliz tili klubi. Tinglang va o‘qing.
scenes.say: City Library. New English Club! Every Saturday from ten to twelve. Room five, second floor. Free for students. Bring a friend!
scenes.say_uz: Shahar kutubxonasi. Yangi ingliz tili klubi! Har shanba soat o‘ndan o‘n ikkigacha. Beshinchi xona, ikkinchi qavat. Talabalar uchun bepul. Do‘stingizni olib keling!

scenes.title: E’lon nima haqida?
board: a) a job in a library (kutubxonada ish)
b) an English club (ingliz tili klubi)
scenes.say_native: Savol: bu e’lon nima haqida? A — kutubxonadagi ish o‘rni. B — ingliz tili klubi. C — kitob do‘koni. Diqqat qiling: “library” so‘zi bor, lekin bu e’lon kutubxona haqidami yoki kutubxonada bo‘ladigan narsa haqidami? Sarlavhadagi eng katta yozuvga qarang va javob bering.
scenes.say: What is the notice about? A, B or C?
scenes.say_uz: E’lon nima haqida? A, B yoki C?

scenes.title: Javob va tuzoq
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javob — B, ingliz tili klubi. Kutubxona bu yerda faqat joy, asosiy fikr emas. Bu imtihonlardagi mashhur tuzoq: matndagi so‘z variantda ham turadi, lekin asosiy fikr boshqa. “Library” so‘zini ko‘rib A ni tanlaganlar shoshilib qoldi. Asosiy fikr ko‘pincha sarlavhaning eng katta va eng yangi qismida: “New English Club!” Undov belgisi ham e’tiborni shu yerga tortyapti.
scenes.say: The answer is B. The library is the place. The club is the main idea.
scenes.say_uz: Javob — B. Kutubxona — joy. Klub — asosiy fikr.

scenes.title: Tinglashda ismlar
board: How do you spell that? — K-A-R-I-M-O-V
scenes.say_native: Endi tinglashga o‘tamiz. Dialoglarda eng ko‘p so‘raladigan tafsilotlar — ism, son va joy. Ismlardan boshlaymiz. Notanish ism eshitsangiz, ko‘pincha keyin harflab aytiladi: “How do you spell that?” Bu yerda birinchi darslarda o‘rgangan alifboni yaxshi bilish kerak, ayniqsa adashtiriladigan harflarni: E va I, G va J, A va R. Ism yozganda doim bosh harf bilan yozing. “Mr” va “Ms” dan keyin familiya keladi, bu ham sizga ismni topishda yordam beradi.
scenes.say: What's your surname? Karimov. How do you spell that? K, A, R, I, M, O, V.
scenes.say_uz: Familiyangiz nima? Karimov. Qanday yoziladi? K, A, R, I, M, O, V.

scenes.title: Tinglashda sonlar
scenes.say_native: Sonlar tinglashda eng xavfli joy. Eslang: “-teen” bilan tugaydigan sonlarda urg‘u oxirida — thir-TEEN, fif-TEEN. “-ty” bilan tugaydiganlarda esa boshida — THIR-ty, FIF-ty. Bundan tashqari, “-teen” dagi “ee” tovushi cho‘ziq. Vaqt ham turli shaklda keladi: “two thirty” yoki “half past two”. Narxda esa ko‘pincha valyuta so‘zi tushib qoladi: “twelve fifty” deyilsa, bu o‘n ikki funt ellik pens degani.
scenes.say: Thirteen. Thirty. Fifteen. Fifty. Half past two. Twelve fifty.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n uch. O‘ttiz. O‘n besh. Ellik. Ikki yarim. O‘n ikki ellik.

scenes.title: -teen va -ty ni adashtirish
board: Not sure? → Sorry, fifteen or fifty?
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek o‘quvchilari ko‘pincha urg‘uni eshitmaydi, chunki o‘zbek tilida sonlarni urg‘u bilan farqlamaymiz: o‘n besh va ellik butunlay boshqa so‘zlar. Shuning uchun quloq urg‘uga emas, so‘zning boshiga qaraydi: “fif…” — va xato qiladi. Maslahat: so‘z oxiridagi cho‘ziq “-teen” ni tinglang. Real hayotda ishonchingiz komil bo‘lmasa, qayta so‘rang: “Sorry, fifteen or fifty?” Bu juda tabiiy savol va inglizlar o‘zlari ham uni beradi.
scenes.say: Sorry, is that fifteen or fifty? Fifteen. One five.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, o‘n beshmi yoki ellikmi? O‘n besh. Bir, besh.

scenes.title: Qaysi sonni eshitdingiz?
scenes.say_native: Tinglang va har bir juftlikdan eshitgan soningizni tanlang. To‘rtta son bo‘ladi. Urg‘u qayerda ekaniga va so‘z oxiridagi cho‘ziq tovushga e’tibor bering. Daftaringizga so‘z bilan emas, raqam bilan yozing, shunda tezroq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Number one: thirty. Number two: fourteen. Number three: seventy. Number four: eighteen.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: o‘ttiz. Ikkinchi: o‘n to‘rt. Uchinchi: yetmish. To‘rtinchi: o‘n sakkiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — o‘ttiz, “THIR-ty”, urg‘u boshida. Ikkinchi — o‘n to‘rt, “four-TEEN”, oxiri cho‘ziq. Uchinchi — yetmish, “SEV-en-ty”. To‘rtinchi — o‘n sakkiz, “eigh-TEEN”. To‘rttadan to‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, qulog‘ingiz juda yaxshi. Xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, tashvishlanmang: bu farqni eshitish uchun mashq kerak, va biz bugun yana sonlarni eshitamiz.
scenes.say: Thirty. Fourteen. Seventy. Eighteen.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ttiz. O‘n to‘rt. Yetmish. O‘n sakkiz.

scenes.title: Tinglashda joylar
board: at the station / at the hotel
next to · opposite · on the left
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi tafsilot — joy. Joy nomlari odatda “at”, “in”, “on” predloglaridan keyin keladi. Masalan, “at the station” — bekatda, “in Room 5” — beshinchi xonada, “on Green Street” — Green ko‘chasida. Ko‘chalar uchun inglizlar ko‘pincha “on” ishlatadi. Shuningdek, oldingi darslarda o‘rgangan joy so‘zlari: “next to” — yonida, “opposite” — qarshisida, “on the left” — chap tomonda. Bu so‘zlarni eshitsangiz, bilingki, hozir joy haqida gap ketyapti.
scenes.say: The café is on Green Street. It's opposite the cinema, next to the bank.
scenes.say_uz: Kafe Green ko‘chasida. U kinoteatr qarshisida, bankning yonida.

scenes.title: Tinglashdan oldin tayyorlaning
board: 1) Read the questions first. (Avval savollarni o‘qing)
2) Who? → name · When? → time · Where? → place
scenes.say_native: Juda muhim strategiya: dialogni eshitishdan oldin savollarni o‘qing. Savoldagi so‘roq so‘zi qanday javob kutilayotganini aytadi. “Who” bo‘lsa — ism yoki odam. “When” yoki “What time” bo‘lsa — vaqt. “Where” bo‘lsa — joy. “How many” yoki “How much” bo‘lsa — son yoki narx. Shunda tinglayotganda quloqingiz aynan shu turdagi so‘zni kutadi. O‘zbek tilida ham shunday: “qachon?” deb so‘rasangiz, javobda vaqt kutasiz.
scenes.say: Before you listen, read the questions. Think: name, number or place?
scenes.say_uz: Tinglashdan oldin savollarni o‘qing. O‘ylang: ismmi, sonmi yoki joymi?

scenes.title: Javob turini toping
board: 2) What floor is the room on?
scenes.say_native: Hozir dialogni eshitmaymiz, faqat savollarni o‘qiymiz. Har bir savolga qanday turdagi javob kerakligini ayting: ismmi, sonmi, joymi yoki vaqtmi? Bu tayyorgarlik keyingi dialogni tinglashda sizga katta yordam beradi, chunki quloq nimani kutishni oldindan biladi.
scenes.say: Name, number, place or time? Read the four questions.
scenes.say_uz: Ism, son, joy yoki vaqt? To‘rtta savolni o‘qing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi savolda familiya kerak — demak, ism, ehtimol harflab aytiladi. Ikkinchisida qavat raqami — son. Uchinchisida “Where” — joy, ehtimol “next to” yoki “on the left” kabi so‘zlar bilan. To‘rtinchisida “What time” — vaqt, balki “from … to …” shaklida. Endi siz nima kutayotganingizni bilasiz. Keyingi sahnada aynan shu savollarga javob beradigan dialogni tinglaysiz.
scenes.say: Now you know what to listen for. Let's listen.
scenes.say_uz: Endi nimani tinglash kerakligini bilasiz. Keling, tinglaymiz.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: mehmonxonada
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Mehmonxona qabulxonasi, kechqurun. Mehmon kelib, xonasini oladi. Savollar ekranda, ularni eslab turing: familiya, xona raqami, qavat, nonushta vaqti va lift qayerdaligi. Hamma so‘zni tushunishga urinmang, faqat kerakli ma’lumotni ushlang. Tinglang.
scenes.say: Good evening. Welcome to the Park Hotel. Hello. I have a booking for two nights. My name is Karimov. How do you spell that? K, A, R, I, M, O, V. Thank you, Mr Karimov. Your room is three one five, on the third floor. Breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant. Thank you. Where is the lift? It's next to the reception, on the left.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kech. Park mehmonxonasiga xush kelibsiz. Salom. Ikki kechaga bron qilganman. Familiyam Karimov. Qanday yoziladi? K, A, R, I, M, O, V. Rahmat, janob Karimov. Xonangiz uch yuz o‘n besh, uchinchi qavatda. Nonushta restoranda yettidan o‘ngacha. Rahmat. Lift qayerda? Qabulxonaning yonida, chap tomonda.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Endi beshta savolga javob bering: mehmonning familiyasi, xona raqami, qavat, nonushta vaqti va lift qayerda. Esingizda qolganini daftaringizga yozing. Xona raqamiga ehtiyot bo‘ling: unda “-teen” yoki “-ty” bormidi? Familiyani harflab yozing.
scenes.say: What's his surname? What's the room number? What floor? What time is breakfast? Where is the lift?
scenes.say_uz: Uning familiyasi nima? Xona raqami qanday? Qaysi qavat? Nonushta soat nechada? Lift qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 5) next to the reception, on the left
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: familiya — Karimov. Xona — uch yuz o‘n besh. Bu yerda raqam ingliz uslubida, raqamma-raqam aytildi: “three one five”. Mehmonxona xonalari va reyslar ko‘pincha shunday o‘qiladi. Qavat — uchinchi, “the third floor”. Nonushta — yettidan o‘ngacha, restoranda. Lift — qabulxona yonida, chap tomonda. Agar besh savoldan to‘rttasiga javob bergan bo‘lsangiz, bu juda yaxshi natija.
scenes.say: His surname is Karimov. The room is three one five, on the third floor. Breakfast is from seven to ten. The lift is next to the reception.
scenes.say_uz: Familiyasi Karimov. Xona uch yuz o‘n besh, uchinchi qavatda. Nonushta yettidan o‘ngacha. Lift qabulxona yonida.

scenes.title: E’lonni tinglang: vokzal
scenes.say_native: Endi vokzaldagi e’lonni tinglang. Bunday e’lonlarda bitta odam gapiradi, tez va ba’zan shovqin ichida. Oldingi darsdagi so‘zlarni eslang: “platform” — poyezd to‘xtaydigan joy, “leave” — jo‘nab ketmoq. Ikkita poyezd haqida gap ketadi. Har biri uchun qayerga borishi, soati va platforma raqamini ushlashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Attention, please. The train to Oxford leaves at ten fifteen from platform four. The train to Bath leaves at ten fifty from platform thirteen. Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Diqqat. Oksfordga boradigan poyezd soat o‘n o‘n beshda to‘rtinchi platformadan jo‘naydi. Batga boradigan poyezd soat o‘n ellikda o‘n uchinchi platformadan jo‘naydi. Rahmat.

scenes.title: Jadvalni to‘ldiring
scenes.say_native: Jadvalni to‘ldiring. Oksford poyezdi soat nechada va qaysi platformadan jo‘naydi? Bat poyezdi-chi? Ehtiyot bo‘ling: e’londa ikkita o‘xshash son bor — biri “fifteen”, biri “fifty”. Yana bir “-teen” son ham bor edi. Vaqtni raqam bilan yozing, masalan, 9:45.
scenes.say: Oxford: what time? What platform? Bath: what time? What platform?
scenes.say_uz: Oksford: soat nechada? Qaysi platforma? Bat: soat nechada? Qaysi platforma?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Oksfordga poyezd soat o‘n o‘n beshda, to‘rtinchi platformadan. Bat poyezdi soat o‘n ellikda, o‘n uchinchi platformadan. Bu mashq qiyin edi, chunki “ten fifteen” va “ten fifty” juda o‘xshash eshitiladi. Shuning uchun real vokzalda ma’lumot taxtasiga ham qarang yoki xodimdan qayta so‘rang: “Sorry, which platform?” — kechirasiz, qaysi platforma?
scenes.say: The Oxford train: ten fifteen, platform four. The Bath train: ten fifty, platform thirteen.
scenes.say_uz: Oksford poyezdi: o‘n o‘n besh, to‘rtinchi platforma. Bat poyezdi: o‘n ellik, o‘n uchinchi platforma.

scenes.title: Kalit so‘zlar nima?
board: Key words = nouns, verbs, numbers, names
a, the, to, at, of, and — small words
scenes.say_native: Endi uchinchi mavzu — kalit so‘z strategiyasi. Har bir gapda ma’noni tashiydigan so‘zlar bor: otlar, fe’llar, sonlar, ismlar, sifatlar. Ular kalit so‘zlar. Yana kichik yordamchi so‘zlar bor: “a”, “the”, “to”, “at”, “of”, “and”. Agar faqat kalit so‘zlarni eshitsangiz ham, ko‘pincha ma’no tushunarli bo‘ladi. Masalan, “sister… London… bank” — opam Londonda bankda ishlaydi, deb taxmin qilish oson.
scenes.say: My sister lives in London and works in a bank. Sister. London. Works. Bank.
scenes.say_uz: Opam Londonda yashaydi va bankda ishlaydi. Opa. London. Ishlaydi. Bank.

scenes.title: Ingliz nutqining ritmi
board: I GET UP at SEVEN and GO to WORK by BUS.
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda talaffuzning muhim siri bor. Ingliz tilida kalit so‘zlar baland va aniq aytiladi, kichik so‘zlar esa juda qisqa va kuchsiz. “To” so‘zi “tə”, “at” — “ət”, “and” — “ən” bo‘lib qoladi. Buni kuchsiz shakllar, “weak forms” deyiladi. O‘zbek tilida har bir bo‘g‘in deyarli bir xil kuch bilan aytiladi, shuning uchun inglizcha nutq bizga juda tez tuyuladi. Aslida ular kichik so‘zlarni yutib yuborishadi. Xulosa: urg‘uli so‘zlarni tinglang, ular kalit so‘zlar.
scenes.say: I get up at seven and go to work by bus.
scenes.say_uz: Men soat yettida turaman va ishga avtobusda boraman.

scenes.title: Kuchli va kuchsiz so‘zlarni eshiting
board: a CUP of TEA → /ə kʌp əv tiː/
scenes.say_native: Yana bir necha misolni tinglang. “A cup of tea” iborasida “cup” va “tea” aniq, “a” va “of” esa deyarli eshitilmaydi: “ə-CUP-əv-TEA”. “Fish and chips” — “FISH-ən-CHIPS”. “Go to the park” — “GO-tə-thə-PARK”. Takrorlab ko‘ring va ritmni his qiling. Kuchsiz shakllarni o‘zingiz ham ishlatsangiz, nutqingiz tabiiyroq eshitiladi va boshqalarning nutqini tushunish ham osonlashadi.
scenes.say: A cup of tea. Fish and chips. Go to the park. A cup of tea, please.
scenes.say_uz: Bir piyola choy. Baliq va kartoshka fri. Bog‘ga bor. Bir piyola choy, iltimos.

scenes.title: Kalit so‘zlarni toping
board: 1) The museum opens at nine on Monday.
2) Tom has two brothers and a sister.
3) Can I have a glass of water, please?
scenes.say_native: Ekrandagi uchta gapda kalit so‘zlarni toping. O‘zingizdan so‘rang: qaysi so‘zlarni olib tashlasam, ma’no yo‘qoladi? Ular kalit so‘zlar. Kichik yordamchi so‘zlarni chetga qo‘ying. Har bir gapdan uch-to‘rtta so‘z tanlang va daftaringizga yozing. Keyin faqat shu so‘zlarni o‘qib ko‘ring: ma’no saqlanib qoldimi?
scenes.say: Find the key words. The museum opens at nine on Monday. Tom has two brothers and a sister. Can I have a glass of water, please?
scenes.say_uz: Kalit so‘zlarni toping. Muzey dushanba kuni soat to‘qqizda ochiladi. Tomning ikki akasi va bir opasi bor. Bir stakan suv bersangiz, iltimos?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar: birinchi gapda — museum, opens, nine, Monday. Ikkinchisida — Tom, two, brothers, sister. Uchinchisida — glass, water, please. Ko‘rdingizmi, faqat shu so‘zlarning o‘zi ham butun ma’noni beradi. Tinglashda ham xuddi shunday: “at”, “on”, “a” ni eshitmay qolsangiz, hech narsa yo‘qotmaysiz. Lekin “nine” yoki “Monday” ni eshitmasangiz, asosiy ma’lumot yo‘qoladi.
scenes.say: Museum, opens, nine, Monday. Tom, two brothers, sister. Glass of water, please.
scenes.say_uz: Muzey, ochiladi, to‘qqiz, dushanba. Tom, ikki aka, opa. Bir stakan suv, iltimos.

scenes.title: Savol boshqa so‘z bilan beriladi
board: Text: I'm a nurse. → Q: Is he a doctor? → No.
Text: at the weekend → Q: on Saturday and Sunday
Text: free → Q: Do students pay? → No.
scenes.say_native: Kalit so‘zlarning yana bir siri: savolda ko‘pincha matndagi so‘zning o‘zi emas, uning sinonimi yoki boshqacha ifodasi ishlatiladi. Matnda “at the weekend” deyilgan bo‘lsa, savolda “on Saturday and Sunday” bo‘lishi mumkin. Matnda “free for students”, savolda esa “Do students pay?” — talabalar pul to‘laydimi? Javob: yo‘q. Shuning uchun faqat bir xil so‘zni qidirmang, ma’noni qidiring.
scenes.say: The text says: free for students. The question asks: do students pay? The answer is no.
scenes.say_uz: Matnda: talabalar uchun bepul. Savol: talabalar pul to‘laydimi? Javob: yo‘q.

scenes.title: Bir xil so‘z tuzog‘i
board: Text: The café is not open on Monday.
Q: Is the café open on Monday?
scenes.say_native: Mana tipik tuzoq. Matnda: “The café is not open on Monday.” Savol: “Is the café open on Monday?” Ko‘pchilik savoldagi “open on Monday” so‘zlarini matnda ko‘radi va darhol “Yes” deydi. Ammo matnda kichkina “not” so‘zi bor. Inkor so‘zlari — “not”, “don’t”, “doesn’t”, “never” — ma’noni butunlay teskari qiladi. Bir xil so‘zlarni topganingizda to‘xtang va butun gapni o‘qing.
scenes.say: The café is not open on Monday. Is the café open on Monday? No, it isn't.
scenes.say_uz: Kafe dushanba kuni ochiq emas. Kafe dushanba kuni ochiqmi? Yo‘q, ochiq emas.

scenes.title: Ma’noni moslang
board: 1) Text: He never drinks coffee. — Q: Does he like coffee?
2) Text: She's a teacher at a school. — Q: Does she work in a hospital?
3) Text: It's 8 a.m. — Q: Is it the evening?
scenes.say_native: Uchta qisqa gap va uchta savol. Savollardagi so‘zlar matndagi so‘zlar bilan bir xil emas, shuning uchun ma’noni o‘ylang. Har biriga “Yes” yoki “No” deb javob bering. Birinchi savolda javob mutlaqo aniq emas, lekin eng mantiqiy javobni tanlang. Inkor so‘zlariga alohida e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: He never drinks coffee. Does he like coffee? She's a teacher at a school. Does she work in a hospital? It's eight a.m. Is it the evening?
scenes.say_uz: U hech qachon qahva ichmaydi. U qahvani yoqtiradimi? U maktabda o‘qituvchi. U kasalxonada ishlaydimi? Soat ertalab sakkiz. Hozir kechqurunmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — ehtimol, yo‘q. U hech qachon qahva ichmaydi, demak, uni yoqtirmasa kerak. Ikkinchi — yo‘q, u maktabda ishlaydi, kasalxonada emas. Uchinchi — yo‘q, “a.m.” tushdan oldingi vaqtni bildiradi, demak hozir ertalab. Bu mashqda bitta ham savol so‘zma-so‘z matnda yo‘q edi. Siz ma’noni tushunib javob berdingiz, bu esa haqiqiy o‘qish va tinglash ko‘nikmasi.
scenes.say: Probably not. No, she doesn't. No, it isn't. It's the morning.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtimol, yo‘q. Yo‘q, ishlamaydi. Yo‘q, kechqurun emas. Hozir ertalab.

scenes.title: Savol turlari
board: Short answer: Where? — In Manchester. (qisqa javob)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu — tushunish savollariga javob berish. Imtihon va darsliklarda uch xil savol ko‘p uchraydi. Birinchisi — “True or False”, to‘g‘ri yoki noto‘g‘ri. Ikkinchisi — variantli savol, “multiple choice”, unda a, b, c dan birini tanlaysiz. Uchinchisi — qisqa javobli savol. Unda bir-ikki so‘z yoki qisqa gap yozasiz. Har bir turning o‘z qoidasi bor, keling, ularni birma-bir ko‘rib chiqamiz.
scenes.say: True or false? Choose a, b or c. Answer the question in two or three words.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘rimi yoki noto‘g‘rimi? A, b yoki c ni tanlang. Savolga ikki-uch so‘z bilan javob bering.

scenes.title: Qisqa javob qoidalari
board: Where does she live? → In Leeds.
Is he a student? → Yes, he is.
Does Tom work? → No, he doesn't.
scenes.say_native: Qisqa javobda savol so‘ziga mos keladigan narsani yozing. “Where” savoliga to‘liq gap shart emas: “In Leeds” yetarli. “What time” ga — “At six”. Agar savol “Is” yoki “Does” bilan boshlansa, oldingi darslardagi qisqa javoblarni ishlating: “Yes, he is”, “No, he doesn’t”. O‘zbek tilida “ha” yoki “yo‘q” deb qo‘yaveramiz, ingliz tilida esa qisqa javobda yordamchi fe’l qaytariladi. Bu og‘zaki savollarda ayniqsa muhim.
scenes.say: Where does she live? In Leeds. Is he a student? Yes, he is. Does Tom work? No, he doesn't.
scenes.say_uz: U qayerda yashaydi? Lidsda. U talabami? Ha, talaba. Tom ishlaydimi? Yo‘q, ishlamaydi.

scenes.title: Qisqa javobdagi xatolar
board: ✗ Does he live in Leeds? — Yes, he is.
✗ Where does she work? — She work bank. → ✓ In a bank.
scenes.say_native: Ikki tipik xato. Birinchisi: “Does” bilan berilgan savolga “Yes, he is” deb javob berish. Qoida oddiy: savol qaysi yordamchi so‘z bilan boshlansa, javobda o‘sha so‘z qaytadi. “Does” — “Yes, he does”. “Is” — “Yes, he is”. “Can” — “Yes, he can”. Ikkinchi xato: javobni yarim gap qilib, grammatikani buzib yozish, masalan, “She work bank.” Yo to‘liq va to‘g‘ri gap yozing: “She works in a bank”, yoki qisqa ibora: “In a bank.”
scenes.say: Does he live in Leeds? Yes, he does. Is he a student? Yes, he is. Can he swim? Yes, he can.
scenes.say_uz: U Lidsda yashaydimi? Ha. U talabami? Ha. U suza oladimi? Ha.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘i
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Anna do‘sti Tomga qo‘ng‘iroq qilib, uchrashishni taklif qiladi. Tinglashdan oldin o‘ylang: qanday tafsilotlar kerak bo‘lishi mumkin? Albatta, qaysi kun, qayerda va soat nechada. Bularni kalit so‘zlar orqali ushlang. Dialogdan keyin to‘rtta savol bo‘ladi. Tinglang.
scenes.say: Hi Tom, it's Anna. Are you free on Saturday? Yes, I am. Why? There's a new café on Green Street. Let's meet there. Great idea! What time? At half past two. It's opposite the cinema. OK, half past two, opposite the cinema. See you on Saturday! Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Salom Tom, bu Anna. Shanba kuni bo‘shmisan? Ha. Nima edi? Green ko‘chasida yangi kafe bor. O‘sha yerda uchrashaylik. Zo‘r fikr! Soat nechada? Ikki yarimda. U kinoteatr qarshisida. Xo‘p, ikki yarimda, kinoteatr qarshisida. Shanba kuni ko‘rishamiz! Xayr!

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 4) True or False: The café is next to the cinema.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi uchtasiga qisqa javob bering: qaysi kun, qaysi ko‘chada va soat nechada. To‘rtinchisi “True or False”: kafe kinoteatrning yonidami? Ehtiyot bo‘ling, bu yerda joy so‘zi muhim. Javoblaringizni yozing, vaqtni esa ikki xil shaklda yozib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: What day do they meet? Where is the café? What time do they meet? True or false: the café is next to the cinema.
scenes.say_uz: Ular qaysi kuni uchrashadi? Kafe qayerda? Ular soat nechada uchrashadi? To‘g‘rimi yoki noto‘g‘rimi: kafe kinoteatr yonida.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — shanba kuni, “On Saturday”. Ikkinchi — Green ko‘chasida. Uchinchi — ikki yarimda, “half past two”. To‘rtinchi — noto‘g‘ri, “False”. Kafe kinoteatrning yonida emas, qarshisida — “opposite”. Mana, kichik joy so‘zi butun javobni o‘zgartirdi. E’tibor bering: Tom vaqt va joyni qaytarib aytdi: “half past two, opposite the cinema”. Bu tekshirishning juda foydali usuli, siz ham shunday qiling.
scenes.say: On Saturday. On Green Street. At half past two. False. It's opposite the cinema.
scenes.say_uz: Shanba kuni. Green ko‘chasida. Ikki yarimda. Noto‘g‘ri. Kafe kinoteatr qarshisida.

scenes.title: Uchinchi matn: xat
board: Hello Jasur, I'm Ben. I'm 28 and I live in Manchester.
I'm a nurse. I work in a big hospital.
My sister Kate is 19. She's a student in London.
At the weekend I play football and cook. Write soon!
scenes.say_native: Endi uchinchi matn — xorijlik do‘stdan kelgan elektron xat. Ben ismli yigit Jasurga o‘zi haqida yozadi. Bu turdagi matnlar imtihonlarda juda ko‘p uchraydi. Avval asosiy fikrni toping: xat nima haqida? Keyin tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering: shahar, kasb, singlisining yoshi va dam olish kunlari. Tinglab, o‘qib boring.
scenes.say: Hello Jasur, thank you for your email. I'm Ben. I'm twenty-eight and I live in Manchester, in the north of England. I'm a nurse. I work in a big hospital. I have a sister, Kate. She's nineteen and she's a student in London. At the weekend I play football and I cook. My favourite food is pasta. Write soon! Ben.
scenes.say_uz: Salom Jasur, xating uchun rahmat. Men Benman. Yigirma sakkiz yoshdaman va Angliya shimolidagi Manchesterda yashayman. Men hamshiraman. Katta kasalxonada ishlayman. Singlim bor, ismi Keyt. U o‘n to‘qqiz yoshda, Londonda talaba. Dam olish kunlari futbol o‘ynayman va ovqat pishiraman. Sevimli taomim — pasta. Tez orada yoz! Ben.

scenes.title: Aralash savollar
board: 1) Main idea: a) Ben's job b) Ben and his life c) London
scenes.say_native: To‘rt xil savol. Birinchisi — asosiy fikr, variantli: a, b yoki c. Ikkinchisi — qisqa javob: Ben qayerda yashaydi? Uchinchisi — ma’no savoli: Ben shifokormi? Matnda “doctor” so‘zi yo‘q, ehtiyot bo‘ling. To‘rtinchisi — to‘g‘ri yoki noto‘g‘ri: Keyt to‘qson yoshda. Javoblaringizni yozing.
scenes.say: What is the email about? Where does Ben live? Is Ben a doctor? True or false: Kate is ninety.
scenes.say_uz: Xat nima haqida? Ben qayerda yashaydi? Ben shifokormi? To‘g‘rimi yoki noto‘g‘rimi: Keyt to‘qson yoshda.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) No, he isn't. He's a nurse.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — B, xat Benning o‘zi va hayoti haqida. A varianti juda tor: ish matnning faqat bir qismi. C esa faqat Keyt bilan bog‘liq tafsilot. Ikkinchi — Manchesterda. Uchinchi — yo‘q, u shifokor emas, hamshira: “No, he isn’t. He’s a nurse.” To‘rtinchi — noto‘g‘ri, Keyt o‘n to‘qqiz yoshda, “nineteen”, to‘qson esa “ninety”. Yana o‘sha “-teen” va “-ty” farqi!
scenes.say: The email is about Ben and his life. He lives in Manchester. He isn't a doctor, he's a nurse. Kate is nineteen.
scenes.say_uz: Xat Ben va uning hayoti haqida. U Manchesterda yashaydi. U shifokor emas, hamshira. Keyt o‘n to‘qqiz yoshda.

scenes.title: Javobingizni tekshiring
board: ✓ Did I answer the question word? (Who/Where/When)
✓ Is there not / never in the text?
scenes.say_native: Javob yozib bo‘lgach, uch narsani tekshiring. Birinchi: javobim savol so‘ziga mosmi? “Where” ga joy, “When” ga vaqt yozdimmi? Ikkinchi: matnda “not” yoki “never” kabi inkor so‘zi yo‘qmi? Uchinchi: ism va sonlarni to‘g‘ri yozdimmi? Ism bosh harf bilan, son esa raqam bilan yozilsa, xato kamroq bo‘ladi. Bu tekshiruv yarim daqiqa oladi, lekin ko‘p ball saqlab qoladi. Keyingi darsdagi imtihonda bu sizga juda kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Check your answers. Question word, negative words, names and numbers.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblaringizni tekshiring. So‘roq so‘zi, inkor so‘zlari, ismlar va sonlar.

scenes.title: Dialogni qayta hikoya qilish
board: Dialogue: I / you → Retell: he / she / they
Anna calls Tom. She wants to meet him.
They meet at half past two.
scenes.say_native: Tushunganingizni ko‘rsatishning eng yaxshi yo‘li — eshitganingizni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan aytib berish. Bunda dialogdagi “I” va “you” uchinchi shaxsga o‘tadi: “he”, “she”, “they”. Hozirgi zamonda “she” bilan fe’lga “-s” qo‘shishni unutmang: “Anna calls”, “She wants”. Bu qoidani oldingi darslarda o‘rgangansiz. O‘zbek tilida ham hikoya qilganda “u qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi, u aytadi” deymiz, ingliz tilida ham xuddi shunday.
scenes.say: Anna calls Tom. She wants to meet him on Saturday.
scenes.say_uz: Anna Tomga qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi. U shanba kuni u bilan uchrashmoqchi.

scenes.title: Dialogni to‘rt gapda aytib bering
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy mashq. Anna va Tomning dialogini to‘rtta gap bilan aytib bering. Ekrandagi reja yordam beradi: kim kimga qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi, qaysi kun, kafe qayerda va soat nechada. “He”, “she”, “they” ni ishlating va fe’lga “-s” qo‘shishni unutmang. Baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Now retell the dialogue in four sentences. Start: Anna calls Tom.
scenes.say_uz: Endi dialogni to‘rt gapda aytib bering. Boshlang: Anna calls Tom.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: She wants to meet him on Saturday.
The café is on Green Street, opposite the cinema.
They meet at half past two.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. “Anna calls Tom. She wants to meet him on Saturday. The café is on Green Street, opposite the cinema. They meet at half past two.” Sizning gaplaringiz biroz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, masalan, “There is a new café” deb boshlash ham to‘g‘ri. Asosiysi, to‘rtta tafsilot ham bor: kim, qachon, qayerda va soat nechada. Fe’llarda “-s” borligiga yana bir bor qarang.
scenes.say: Anna calls Tom. She wants to meet him on Saturday. The café is on Green Street, opposite the cinema. They meet at half past two.
scenes.say_uz: Anna Tomga qo‘ng‘iroq qiladi. U shanba kuni u bilan uchrashmoqchi. Kafe Green ko‘chasida, kinoteatr qarshisida. Ular ikki yarimda uchrashadi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: Main idea: title, first sentence, repeated words
Key words + weak forms (tə, ət, ən)
Answers: question word, not/never, short answers
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Asosiy fikrni sarlavha, birinchi gap va takrorlangan so‘zlar orqali topamiz. Har bir so‘zni tarjima qilmaymiz. Tafsilotlar uchun avval savollarni o‘qiymiz va qanday javob kutilishini bilamiz: ism, son, joy yoki vaqt. “-teen” va “-ty” ni urg‘u orqali farqlaymiz. Kalit so‘zlar urg‘uli, kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz aytiladi. Savoldagi so‘z matnda boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, “not” ga ehtiyot bo‘lamiz.
scenes.say: Great work today! You can find the main idea, hear names, numbers and places, and answer questions.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun zo‘r ishladingiz! Endi asosiy fikrni topa olasiz, ism, son va joylarni eshitasiz va savollarga javob berasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Retell a short dialogue in 4 sentences.
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Bugungi mehmonxona dialogini yoki o‘zingiz eshitgan boshqa qisqa dialogni to‘rtta gap bilan yozing va baland ovozda aytib bering. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: to‘rtta gapda kim, qachon, qayerda va qancha yoki soat nechada degan savollarga javob bor; “he”, “she”, “they” ishlatilgan; uchinchi shaxs fe’lida “-s” bor. Keyingi darsda butun A1 darajasini takrorlaymiz va yakuniy imtihonni topshiramiz. Ko‘rishguncha!
scenes.say: Your homework: retell a short dialogue in four sentences. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: qisqa dialogni to‘rt gapda aytib bering. Keyingi safar ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Qisqa dialogni (masalan, darsdagi mehmonxona dialogini) 4 ta gap bilan yozing va baland ovozda aytib bering. Mezon: kim, qachon, qayerda va soat nechada yoki qancha degan savollarga javob bor; he/she/they ishlatilgan; uchinchi shaxs fe’lida -s bor (Anna calls, she wants).

quiz.q: You read a text for the first time. What is the best first step?
options: Translate every word with a dictionary
Read it once to the end and find the main idea
Learn all new words by heart first
quiz.why_uz: Avval matnni bir marta oxirigacha o‘qib, asosiy fikrni topamiz; har bir so‘zni tarjima qilish vaqtni yeydi.

quiz.q: Where can you often find the main idea of a short text?
options: In the title and the first sentence
In the small words like a and the
quiz.why_uz: Asosiy fikr ko‘pincha sarlavhada va birinchi gapda bo‘ladi, takrorlangan so‘zlar ham yordam beradi.

quiz.q: You hear: “Room fifTEEN.” Which number is it?
The question is “When does the club meet?” What kind of answer do you need?
quiz.why_uz: When — qachon, demak vaqt yoki kun kerak.

quiz.q: Which words are key words in: “The bus leaves at six from the station.”?
quiz.why_uz: Kalit so‘zlar — otlar, fe’llar va sonlar: bus, leaves, six, station.

quiz.q: How do we usually say “to” in “go to work”?
options: We don't say it at all
quiz.why_uz: Kichik so‘zlar kuchsiz shaklda aytiladi: to = /tə/.

quiz.q: Text: “The shop is not open on Sunday.” Question: “Is the shop open on Sunday?”
quiz.why_uz: Matnda not bor. Savol is bilan, demak javob: No, it isn’t.

quiz.q: Text: “I'm a nurse.” Question: “Is she a doctor?”
options: No, she isn't. She's a nurse.
quiz.why_uz: Savolda boshqa so‘z ishlatilgan: nurse — hamshira, doctor emas. Is savoliga isn’t bilan javob beramiz.

quiz.q: “Does Ben live in Manchester?” Choose the correct short answer.
quiz.why_uz: Savol Does bilan boshlangan, qisqa javobda ham does qaytadi: Yes, he does.

quiz.q: Dialogue: “I'm free on Saturday.” Retell it correctly.
quiz.why_uz: Qayta hikoyada I → she bo‘ladi va to be fe’li is shaklida keladi: She is free.
